vibe: Premium publishing house, classic literature meets modern SaaS. Minimalist, tactile, and highly legible.

background.description: Pale Ivory / Paper texture feel. Use for body background.

surface.description: Pure white for cards, slightly darker ivory for secondary panels.

text.description: Deep stone for headings, lighter stone for body. Avoid pure black. Wine Red for strong emphasis.

accent.description: Deep Wine Red / Burgundy. Reminiscent of classic leather book bindings and ink.

rules.overline: text-xs font-sans uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-[#722F37] font-semibold
rules.custom_instruction: NEVER use Inter, Roboto, or generic fonts for headings. Mix Playfair Display italics for emotional words inside headings (e.g., 'Crea il tuo capolavoro').

layout_and_spacing.general: Generous spacing. Use p-8 to p-12 for containers. Let the text breathe like a printed book page.
layout_and_spacing.bento_grid: For the Character Manager and Dashboard, use a 'Control Room' grid but with editorial aesthetics: sharp 1px borders, white backgrounds on ivory canvas.
layout_and_spacing.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use border-collapse styles or right/bottom borders to separate items instead of heavy floating cards.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Left-align dense text and forms. Center-align hero titles.

buttons.primary: bg-[#722F37] text-white hover:bg-[#5C252C] rounded-sm px-6 py-3 font-sans font-medium transition-all duration-300
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#E7E5E4] text-[#1C1917] hover:border-[#1C1917] rounded-sm px-6 py-3 font-sans transition-all duration-300

inputs.style: bg-transparent border-0 border-b-2 border-[#E7E5E4] rounded-none focus:ring-0 focus:border-[#722F37] px-0 py-2 text-lg
inputs.description: Forms should feel like filling out lines in a notebook. Avoid full boxed inputs for the 'Idea' section.

cards.style: bg-white border border-[#E7E5E4] rounded-sm shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow
cards.book_cover: For generated books, show the cover image with a slight drop-shadow (shadow-xl) against a solid background to mimic a real book standing up.

header.style: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-[#FDFBF7]/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#E7E5E4]

motion.hover: Subtle and organic. 200ms ease for color shifts. Use slight -translate-y-1 for book covers on hover.
motion.page_transitions: Fade in with a slight upward drift (framer-motion).
motion.reading_view: Smooth scrolling (Lenis) is mandatory for the reading experience.

image_urls.description: Abstract minimalist ink spill. Use as an accent graphic in the hero section (e.g., positioned to the right of the text or as a faded background element with mix-blend-multiply).
Elegant botanical silhouette. Use as the default avatar for characters in the Character Manager before an AI generates their specific look.
Floating blank book mockup. Use in the Book Library/Dashboard as placeholders or composite generated covers over this.
Vintage paper texture. Can be used with opacity-10 and mix-blend-multiply over solid color blocks to give a tactile feel.

testing.rules: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='generate-book-btn', data-testid='character-name-input'). Use kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: The entire app UI MUST be in Italian, as requested.
Implement the 'Idea Input' as a multi-step, distraction-free wizard, not a dense form. It should feel like a premium writing experience.
For the 'Character Manager', use a Bento Grid layout to display strengths, weaknesses, and traits prominently, resembling a dossier or character sheet.
For the 'Book Reader', prioritize extreme legibility: max-w-prose (max-w-[65ch]), large serif typography for chapter titles, and generous line-height for body text.
Do NOT use generic Shadcn forms out of the box. Strip the borders and styles to match the 'lines in a notebook' inputs specified in the design guidelines.
Install 'lucide-react' for icons. You can also use 'framer-motion' for page transitions.
Do not use dark mode. Stick strictly to the Light Editorial theme with Ivory/Wine Red colors to maintain the classic publishing aesthetic.
